# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Second Penance

---

**1** 'Go and bring Eve,' Michael said to Adam. Adam went and found Eve standing in the Tigris River.

**2** Adam took Eve by the hand and brought her out of the water, then told her everything Michael had said.

**3** Eve wept: 'I have failed. I didn't hold out in my penance the way you held out in yours. But maybe the Lord will forgive me because of what you did.'

**4** 'Don't cry,' Adam said to Eve. 'God is merciful. He will have compassion on us.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
